articles.content:
What if you started from nothing in skyrim. A character with no health, no stamina, no magika. I mean people have done no magic runs of skyrim, no stamina walks and no hit runs but combining all of them together is crazy.

Want a good drink? Checkout Holy here http://uk.holy.com/brit

BUT THEN IT GETS WORSE!!!! What if you also start with 0 for all skills and stats. (thankfully movement speed is only lowered to 70%). This means you start out with no carry weight and physically cannot do much moving or fighting. Effectively we are a twig that can do nothing but hope that they can leach some skills and stats off of the world. Our only advantage is as we defeat enemies we are given random skills so provided we spend enough time improving we too can become an unstoppable force in this game.

So our goal is simple. Defeat Karstag the strongest enemy in the game.
However ontop of this challenge we will also be playing on maximum difficulty legendary survival mode meaning we have to eat and sleep, we cannot fast travel and all enemies just got a lot more challenging.

This video is a really special project I want to thank Nethalythic for making the stats on kill mod. I also want to shoutout @Joov for suggesting this challenge on legendary survival mode difficulty it was a blast! Of course our sponsors at holy have helped a bunch too! I hope you enjoyed watching it of course because this is a super special project with funny moments, bugs and exploits a plenty to entertain us on the journey to making an overpowered god character!

You can grab the mod used here and please consider supporting nethalythic: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/183621

articles.author: The Spiffing Brit

The Goal Is Simple reach the rank of city in the game by growing our starting village but we will attempt to do so with our tax rates locked at the highest possible setting of 30%. At this rate our society will struggle massivel
articles.content:
Welcome one and all to a very silly challenge run of cities skylines 2. The Goal Is Simple reach the rank of city in the game by growing our starting village but we will attempt to do so with our tax rates locked at the highest possible setting of 30%. At this rate our society will struggle massively from a lack of income and profits as well as people not willing to live in a city with high taxation. We will have to use some silly strategies to make this work but hey you are watching the spiffing brit and if there is one thing I like to do its to break games by not playing them the intended way! So can we complete this challenge is it even possible there is only one way to find out!

Cities: Skylines II of course had a very rough launch and struggled to find its feet but now several years of updates and DLC later and an entire dev team switch with iceflake getting switched in by paradox interactive it will be interesting to see how the game has changed and improved. If for some reason you need a link to the game and want to grab it on a steam sale there here is a link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/949230/Cities_Skylines_II/

Whilst I do have mixed feelings about the game it is still a competent city builder with a mix of simulation, sandbox and management gameplay that is just hard to find elsewhere.

articles.content:
So I went to Gamescom 2026 the biggest gaming convention I think we have left after the collapse of E3. The event is a multi day long mix of business, social and gaming in the german city of cologne. Whilst there are hundreds of thousands of germans attending for fun my reasons for being there are largely as a content creator doing cool business things! This stream is going to be a presentation that I have put together about my trip to the city, the things I saw, the people I met and the amazing games I got to see.

Now my tavel today was covered by the developers of Transport Fever 3 which allowed me to get to gamescom this year which was very nice!
